page_title: UDI 1-1 CAG | Udinese v Cagliari 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Alberto Arena interrupts the game.
90+3' Udinese fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.

90+1' Keinan Davis (Udinese) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
90+1' Half-chance! Keinan Davis (Udinese) plays a pass into the box, but Elia Caprile reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Fouls committed – 12:15.
87' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
86' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) replaces Alessandro Zanoli.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jakub Piotrowski departs the field of play to be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
85' Arthur Atta (Udinese) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
83' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Sebastiano Esposito and he is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adam Obert as he is replaced by Nicolo Cavuoti (Cagliari).
81' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
80' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
78' A sweet pass inside the box gives Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Zaniolo leaves the pitch and Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) comes on.
77' Adam Obert (Cagliari) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
74' Good chance! Keinan Davis laid the ball off to Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
72' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zito Luvumbo is coming onto the pitch as Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) tries to find Saba Goglichidze, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
71' The free kick into the penalty area from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is cleared.

70' Arthur Atta (Udinese) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
69' Adam Obert (Cagliari) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Udinese will take a free kick.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:6. Shots on target – 3:2.

67' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Kosta Runjaic has decided that Nicolo Bertola is the man to take his place.
66' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is able to continue to play. Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.

62' The game is interrupted now, Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! The corner comes over and Oumar Solet flicks on with his head to Christian Kabasele (Udinese), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
58' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
57' The ball is cleared after Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Udinese force their opponents to concede a corner.
57' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
54' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
53' Marco Palestra plays a lofted ball into Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
51' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries to find Nicolo Zaniolo, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
50' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared.
50' Arthur Atta (Udinese) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adam Obert (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Alberto Arena didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
47' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) will take a corner kick.
46' Fabio Pisacane makes a half-time substitution. Alessandro Di Pardo comes on in place of Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
43' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gets to a rebound from the corner kick and unleashes a long-range shot. Promising try, but it goes way wide of the left post.
43' The resulting corner from Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
40' Arthur Atta (Udinese) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
39' Arthur Atta (Udinese) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
36' Great save! Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Elia Caprile.

36' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) receives a pin-point pass in the middle of the pitch which gives him a great opportunity to score. He is unfazed by the distance and slams the ball towards the goal. He is unlucky as he hits one of his own teammates.
34' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes a short free kick.
34' Referee Alberto Arena sees the trip by Marco Palestra (Cagliari) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Udinese.
32' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Razvan Sava.
31' 4:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:2.
30' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the corner with a short pass.
28' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Elia Caprile punches the ball away.
28' Arthur Atta (Udinese) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Elia Caprile sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top left corner.
27' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alberto Arena no option but to blow his whistle.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
24' Oumar Solet (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

23' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Razvan Sava pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
22' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
21' This is a yellow card! Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
20' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is substituted due to injury. Fabio Pisacane gives a chance to Michel Adopo.
19' Alberto Arena blows his whistle as Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
18' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
17' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) attempts to release Keinan Davis with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
17' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 63:37.
15' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) jumps into a tackle and Alberto Arena signals a foul.
13' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
12' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
10' Arthur Atta loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Keinan Davis (Udinese).
8' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post!
7' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Alberto Arena had a clear view and blows his whistle.
5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
4' Arthur Atta (Udinese) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
4' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Udinese earn a free kick.
3' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
2' Alberto Arena blows his whistle. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alberto Arena.
